verdict.rationale: The pack documents no bulk or full-account export feature and no open export formats such as CSV or JSON dumps. The 'import-and-export' knowledge-base pages quoted cover only importing and transferring data into HubSpot. API record retrieval and MCP read access are developer building blocks for building an export yourself, not a documented capability to export all data and leave, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
